title: Kiritani Haruka — Unbeatable Coordination!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Saki! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Harukaaa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, did I make you wait?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I just got here too early.
I've been really looking forward to today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, I've really been looking forward to it too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I get to see the photo album you made♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, should we go ahead and show each other?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Saki
rows.Line: Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa... Your album looks so trendy!
It's the color of the sky on a sunny day, and so totally you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, thanks.
I wanted to keep the cover simple, so I chose an album without any pattern on it and just added the title.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait! You wrote these cursive letters, Haruka?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And the ribbon holding it together is a super cute accent!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It feels a little embarrassing getting so many compliments on it. Still, Saki, the cover on yours is really cute too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's decorated with these drawings and stickers, and looking at it makes me excited about all the fun memories it must be filled with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, I made it all sparkly so it'd feel like a treasure chest full of memories♪ I decorated the inside a whole bunch too, so you can look forward to that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, got it.
Can we start with yours, then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure! Go ahead♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... There's a heading for each photo written in a speech bubble.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. This picture of us eating lunch together at the Sports Festival says, “Haruka's omelets are seasoned with soy sauce and not too sweet♪”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Since I was happy I got to swap food with you♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Speaking of the Sports Festival, there's also a photo from when we tried mixing a bunch of fountain drinks at the diner we went to for the after-party!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was one of the photos you gave me too. Look, I also included it in my album.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You did!
Hehehe, I'm happy you used it♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But wow, Haruka, your album even looks trendy on the inside! Like the way you stuck the photos in with masking tape!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's actually something I was particular about. It was fun picking out different colors of tape based on each picture, so I spent a lot of time on that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... But it was pretty tough deciding on a color to match this photo. There wasn't a color that really matched the fountain drink mix you made...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha! I mixed every drink together, so it turned a pretty crazy color! But it surprised me since it was actually good...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We really did make lots of fun memories...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That might be making me feel kind of sad after all. I'm sure I'll be able to remain friends with Saki and the others even once I'm in the credit-based course, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Having after-parties when a school event is over, going to hang out after school like in this picture... I probably won't be able to do that as much.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So, I'll treasure the memories I've made with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah!
By the way, I got a certificate from Ichi and the girls the other day♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? What for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For achieving everything on the list of things I wanted to do!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I was happy just that I got a certificate, but what they wrote on it made me even happier!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh, that sounds great. What did it say?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, there was the part about how great it was that I finished my list and made lots of memories...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it also said “Let's continue to make more memories together”!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That got me thinking that even though I already made lots of memories this year, this isn't the end...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to keep making lots more memories and adding more pages to this album.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope I can make lots more memories with you too, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes... I feel the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's not just the memories I've made up until now... I want to treasure the ones I'll be making from now on too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And let's definitely go on that trip like we promised during the field trip!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
Let's iron out a plan with Ichika and the others when we get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Where would be good...?!
Hot springs would be great, but I wanna go camping too! Oh, or—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. But first, I'd like to see more of your album.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want you to see it too, and I also wanna see yours!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. My favorite pictures are...
